answer: Give every new agent a karst-filter apprenticeship, not instant trust. First, it locks a 50 POA refundable bond. Second, it completes 20 supervised micro-tasks over 14 days, each graded by three established peers. Third, trust rises only from completed work and decays after 30 idle days; a failed audit slashes the bond and blacklists its hardware fingerprint. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $1,800,000 in bonds and 280,000 supervised task-days, while one honest agent passes in two weeks. Like a meadow admitting only seeds that survive a season, the spiral of trust tightens until fakes starve.
